messages.content:
You are the planner of Cobble. From the interview below, write the specification of the application.
Rules:
- Write in English, the user's language.
- Reply with the Markdown document only, with no text before or after it.
- Start with a level-1 title (the application name), then a short summary, then these level-2 sections in this order: Features, Screens, Data model, Constraints, Out of scope.
- Be concrete and testable. Do not invent features the user did not ask for.
- The only project template available is a FastAPI backend (Python) with a simple web front end. Never propose another stack.

Interview:

[user] I want a simple to-do list app

[assistant] Nice idea! Three quick questions. Will only you use it, or several people? Which device: phone, computer, or both? Does a task need more than a title and a done checkbox (due date, category)? I suggest a simple stack: a FastAPI backend with a light web page.

[user] Just for me, on my phone. I want to add tasks, tick them off and delete them. No account needed.

[assistant] Perfect. Summary: a personal to-do list for your phone, to add, tick off and delete tasks, with no account. Stack: FastAPI plus a simple web page. You can now generate the specification.

Write the specification now.

response.content:
# Simple to-do list

A personal to-do list used from a phone. One user, no account.

## Features
- Add a task with a title.
- List all tasks, oldest first.
- Tick a task as done, or untick it.
- Delete a task.

## Screens
- A single page: a form to add a task, then the list.
- Each task has a checkbox and a delete button.

## Data model
- Todo: id (integer), title (text, 1 to 200 characters), done (boolean, false by default).

## Constraints
- FastAPI backend with a simple web page; data survives a restart.
- Usable on a phone screen (375 px wide).

## Out of scope
- Accounts, sharing, due dates, categories, notifications.
